gen-gf-oxanium-gf-menbere: Every stroke in Oxanium runs like drawn cable, one thickness from start to finish. Menbere sits below in tall, stacked lowercase, and it takes a modest body size to keep that height from crowding.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mitr: Oxanium sets a high-standing, commanding display voice, drawn as if with a fixed pen that never shifts its pressure. Mitr's lowercase nearly touches its capitals in height, so long text feels compact.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-momo-trust-display: Oxanium draws every stroke at a single unit width, start to finish. Momo Trust Display answers with drifting, spaced-out letters and a generous lowercase, and that looseness is what makes the pair stand out.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mukta: Oxanium makes no visible difference between its upright and sideways strokes, giving headings a machined, commanding look. Mukta follows with tall-bodied small letters, so a long passage would feel upright and orderly.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mukta-mahee: One stroke width runs through the whole Oxanium alphabet. Mukta Mahee brings chunky, tall lowercase underneath, so the sharp display lettering gets a friendlier, sturdier partner on the page.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar reads neutral and approachable, with ascenders cut short and compact. And Oxanium's bold, uniform letters head it, so the body can stay at a modest size without losing ground.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mukta-vaani: Oxanium's round letters have rims exactly as thick as their stems. It handles commanding display work, while Mukta Vaani's high-waisted lowercase does the quieter job of carrying text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-narnoor: Commanding and distinctive, Oxanium finishes every stroke at the same measured thickness, which gives headings a stamped look. Narnoor handles the text, with short ascenders above big bowls.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display reads approachable, with a big, tall middle zone in every word. But Oxanium is the one that grabs attention, its diagonals as heavy as its verticals, while the body simply carries the text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-play: Play keeps its capitals and lowercase close in height, with a faint weight shift between strokes. Oxanium's pen never changes pressure or angle, and that stiff, uniform line against Play's gentle thick-thin is the pair's strongest quality.
